correctness.rationale: The proof reduces u-bar(u) to length-k arcs inside the circular symmetric difference of one minority run and its translate. It distinguishes interior shifts, adjacent shifts, and the balanced full-complement shift, then proves all admitted phases give distinct words. It treats all positive a,b,k, including k at or beyond the primitive period, without finite-experiment inference. An extracted standalone checker agrees on 44,528 triples and 462 full finite-count cases.

originality.rationale: Comparison of statements and implications: the inspected primary papers study antisquare avoidance, minimal forbidden antisquares, or antisquares in aperiodic Sturmian words, not the exact order-by-order multiplicity of every complementary-square factor in \((0^a1^b)^\omega\). Separate direct-claim searches did not locate a stronger result implying the two-parameter spectrum. No bibliographic search proves uniqueness; possible unindexed equivalences remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed earlier equivalent classification or simple specialization of unpublished notes cannot be excluded.
The same word "antisquare" is sometimes used incorrectly as a synonym for a two-antipower; this is not the complement condition and must not be conflated.
